name: MoonJuice
description: Library for TASBox's custom scripting language that transpiles to Lua.
In most cases you won't need to use this, as the Luau library automatically transpiles MoonJuice scripts ending in `.mj`.

functions.name: toLuau
functions.description: Transpiles the provided MoonJuice source code to Luau, returning any syntax errors.

returns.name: transpiledSource
returns.description: Transpiled Luau source code. Only valid if there are no errors.

returns.name: syntaxErrors
returns.description: List of syntax errors in the provided source.

classes.name: MoonJuiceError
classes.description: Syntax error in MoonJuice source code.

properties.name: start
properties.description: Start of the error in the source code.

properties.name: end
properties.description: End of the error in the source code.

classes.name: MoonJuicePosition
classes.description: Describes a location in MoonJuice source code by its line and column numbers.
